Shows what Factory Seat 1.2 adds to the round briefing.

![The overlay with the AI Strength row and the stakes line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Milky28/factory-seat-companion/main/docs/images/overlay-ai-strength-stakes.png)

- **AI Strength advice.** When Factory Seat has advice from practice or earlier races, a blue AI Strength row says how to move LMU's slider, such as "Raise 3%", and the To do line repeats it. Factory Seat can't see the slider and LMU doesn't report it, so it's a Check row that never blocks READY TO RACE.
- **What's at stake.** A gold line under the checklist shows the first two lines of the briefing's stakes, such as your championship position and the drivers either side of you.
- **Taller overlay.** The overlay is now 720×436 to fit the new line. The installer resets SimHub's cached size.

Both need Factory Seat 1.2 or later. With 1.1 the overlay works as before.
